retrievalProfile.description: A close-up male portrait with a soft-focus, warm-toned film aesthetic and heavy slab-serif typography anchored in the top-left corner.

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, three-quarter view portrait of a man with dark hair, characterized by soft lighting and a muted, warm color palette. The composition is dominated by the face, with text stacked in the upper-left quadrant using bold, heavy-weight slab serif fonts.
coreVisualRelationships: Text is strictly justified to the top-left margin
Portrait gaze is directed away from the camera
Soft-focus background blends with the subject's hair
Typography overlaps the upper portion of the subject's head
coreInvariants: Heavy slab-serif typeface for primary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale close-up portrait filling 80% of the frame, positioned slightly off-center to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eye and the bold white text in the top-left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold white text, moves down to the blue subtitle, then follows the subject's gaze toward the right edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with the subject's head and shoulders.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm skin tones and dark brown hair
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted sky blue for secondary text
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a warm, slightly hazy value range typical of 1970s film.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or high-saturation digital colors
Limit to earth tones, white, and one muted accent color

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif with square terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Hyphens and dots are simplified geometric blocks
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic typeface family with color-based hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serifs and blocky structure.
Provides the vintage geometric slab feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus, warm-toned 1970s style portrait of a man with dark hair, three-quarter view, looking away from the camera, with a tight crop on the face and shoulders.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of uppercase slab-serif text in the top-left corner. The top line should be white and extra-bold; the second line should be a muted sky blue and slightly smaller.

verificationChecks: Is the text justified to the top-left?
Is the font a heavy slab serif?
Is the portrait in soft focus with warm tones?
Does the text overlap the subject's hair?

mustRedesign: Ensure text is not placed in the bottom half
postGenerationChecks: Ensure top-left text alignment is precise
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait(Close-up, Soft-focus, 70s Film) + Typography(Top-Left, Slab-Serif, Stacked, Two-Color)
